comment: userinfo accepts the access token only in the Authorization header; sending it in the form body is a MAY (RFC 6750 2.2) and not implemented (docs/authorization-server.md)
userinfo returns only name and preferred_username for profile: AD has no source for the other profile claims (nickname, birthdate, ...)
email is issued in the ID token rather than only via userinfo; a SHOULD in OIDC Core 5.4 (docs/authorization-server.md)
same as oidcc-scope-email: email is issued in the ID token
acr / acr_values are not implemented (docs/authorization-server.md); acr_values is a voluntary claim request
the claims request parameter is not implemented (docs/authorization-server.md), so an essential name is not returned via userinfo
the module expects the OP keys to be rotated by hand before it starts; rotation here is a redeploy with a new key first in iam.signing-keys (docs/authorization-server.md), which this run cannot do
